fixtureByteNote: Exact bytes from the independent Windows checkouts are retained here. Checkout line endings can differ from the source Git blob; both Before/After fixture hashes match this retained copy.
captureHashNote: In provenance.json captures, sha256 identifies the PNG named by file. Exact capture-record JSON hashes are separately bound in artifact-digests.json. Do not interpret that field as the JSON record digest.
retention: Append-only clarification; original provenance and evidence commits remain retained. Evidence branch must never be merged into product history.
